title: [spec-gap][R-GATT-005] Gateway bt-at-reception MUST (K.9.2) unimplementable today: no BLE GATT notification ingestion path in any stack
description: Requirement (K.9.2 MUST): GATT notifications lack timestamps; the Gateway MUST add bt (base time) at reception. Second clause (keyword-less, SHOULD-strength): if the BLE device advertises Current Time Service (0x1805), prefer device time. Classification: not-implemented. Evidence: no BLE GATT notification receiver exists in any stack (all BLE code is transport: Meshtastic GATT emulation, KISS-over-BLE, LCI SLIP-over-GATT, IPSP — see umbrella bead project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.201), so there is no reception site at which to stamp bt; Current Time Service 0x1805 client: absent (rg zero). The bt wire field itself is already implemented+tested in all three SenML stacks (rust/lichen-senml/src/wire.rs:35,166,302,440; python/src/lichen/senml/codec.py label map + test_full_fields_vector.py; C lichen/subsys/lichen/senml/include/lichen/senml.h:128-146), so the remaining work is the gateway-side stamping at notification ingestion plus CTS-device-time preference. Suggested placement: BLE relay ingress in lichen/apps/gateway (C) and the future Rust/Python GATT relay — stamp bt at reception, override with CTS time when advertised; note appendix F.12 conditions bt on wall_clock_valid for constrained nodes (python/src/lichen/senml/relative_time.py) — gateways are not constrained nodes and MUST stamp. Priority 3 because it is unreachable until the relay feature (b7z9.201) exists.
